items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: And Cook hired me to play. So I went out there and worked from 8 to 12.

ctx.x: I don't know whether you get that kind of art. Oh.

Boy named Cook. He was the hardest, pip, they call him, in. Yeah. In Thurville. Yeah. Diamond and his garters and all over. His mouth. Diamond, sir? Yeah. Yeah, about the biggest funeral. I loved him, but I began to get a tomache after I ate too much.
